page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.6xlarge is a storage-focused instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor. It features 24 dedicated physical cores (24 vCPUs) running at 2.5 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. The server is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. A key hardware characteristic is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 70,866 GB of HDD storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance tradeoff between single-threaded and multi-threaded operations. Single-core CPU performance is weak, falling into the bottom 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, with single-threaded gzip compression scoring in the bottom 10%. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by average ratings in multi-threaded stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth also performs at an average level for both small and large block reads and writes, though the overall Passmark memory score is weak.

Given the massive 70 TB HDD storage capacity coupled with average multi-threaded processing capabilities, this instance is designed for storage-intensive workloads. It is highly suitable for large-scale data warehousing, log processing, big data analytics, and cold storage applications where high capacity is prioritized over high-speed SSD IOPS. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the server offers a high density of local storage per resource unit, making it a viable option for organizations requiring massive local data retention without the premium cost of solid-state drives.
